definitions.explanation: A person given to daydreaming or unrealistic fancies, often someone whose ideas are impractical. Can be mildly critical (out of touch with reality) or admiring (imaginative).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{昔|むかし}から{空想家|くうそうか}だ。
examples.english: He has always been a dreamer.

examples.japanese: {空想家|くうそうか}の{兄|あに}は、{現実的|げんじつてき}な{弟|おとうと}とよく{対比|たいひ}される。
examples.english: My dreamer older brother is often contrasted with his realistic younger brother.

examples.japanese: ただの{空想家|くうそうか}と{言|い}われていた{彼女|かのじょ}の{考|かんが}えが、{後|のち}に{実現|じつげん}した。
examples.english: Her ideas, once dismissed as those of a mere dreamer, were later realized.

notes:
Compound of {空想|くうそう} (fantasy, daydream) + {家|か} (a suffix for a person characterized by something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ただの{空想家|くうそうか}: a mere dreamer
- {大|だい}の{空想家|くうそうか}: a great fantasist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夢想家|むそうか}: dreamer; visionary — near-synonym, often more positive (an idealistic visionary)
- {現実家|げんじつか}: realist — antonym; a practical, down-to-earth person
